meta.title: Pantheon 2.0 — teaser
meta.note: Seconds are the source of truth; every time here is a whole number of frames at 60 fps. Picture (Remotion) and audio (Python) both read this file.

shots.name: Prompt
shots.what: A glass prompt card on a daylight table: the instruction that made this film.

shots.name: Archive
shots.what: The Columbus incident report; a robot-held pen circles 'desync'.

shots.name: Three spheres
shots.what: Three steel spheres settle in a triangle on paper; iron filings draw the field that links them.

shots.name: Bodies
shots.what: The sheet develops cyanotype blue; the white field lines become the motion paths of three bodies.

shots.name: Glass + seal
shots.what: A thick glass disc slides across the drawings; cut to the report on the stamp's impact, a gloved human hand holding the page.

shots.name: CrossBody-12
shots.what: Twelve body cards drop onto the stamped report, faster and faster.

shots.name: Convergence
shots.what: Everything on the table slides into one point as daylight falls to dusk; the point glows clay.

transitions.how: A gripper lifts the glass card straight up toward the lens; the incident report lies beneath it.
A second gripper drags the report off to the left, uncovering the sheet beneath just as the spheres roll in.
The spheres roll apart and stretch the field; a band of sunlight sweeps the sheet and it develops blue, leaving the filing lines white.
A gripper pushes a thick optical disc left to right; the drawings swell and bend under it.
Hard cut on the stamp's impact, to the incident report lying at the side of the table.
The gloved hand slides off the page; the camera eases toward the point and the first body card drops onto the stamped report.
Cards, sheets, glass, spheres and props slide toward one point while daylight falls to dusk.
Clunky on purpose: one frame of flare as the point ignites fully, then black like a heavy switch.

text.prompt: Make a 20-second film for July 8. Use only what's on this table.
report: INCIDENT REPORT — COLUMBUS DISTRIBUTION CENTER — 14 MAR 2033
Cause: weight update rejected at dock; Reflex/Core desync

cold pad D-A-E-F detuned; muted pulse on each beat from 3.0
pulse follows the card flashes and accelerates; high glassy arpeggio
noise + sine sweep up, filter opening; ends exactly at the cut
one soft low piano-like D3, long reverb

motif.where: the three sphere tinks, the card blips climbing it, resolved by the final D
